description: This file defines Express.js routes for handling CRUD operations related to LLM cost records, including listing, retrieving by ID, creating, updating, and deleting records. It also includes Swagger API documentation annotations.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list LLM cost records with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a specific LLM cost record by ID.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new LLM cost record.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing LLM cost record by ID.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to delete an LLM cost record by ID.
